set.body: From the S6.5 review. Neither TrialFixations, TrialPreview nor AdmittedFixation carries a trial extent, and the last fixation's offset is not the trial duration. The board's inspector line 'Extent · fixations 5.0 s · 13 · 1 outside' needs a served value.
set.title: Serve a trial's extent (duration) so the inspector and timeline can show 'Extent'
